meta.description: Fills the tube of every path with thin strands that follow it. Strands thin where the path thins and never leave its tube.

plant.description: The guide paths, every one becomes a bundle of strands

thickness.description: Thickness of a strand where the guide is thickest, it thins with the guide

thickness_variation.description: How much thinner than the thickness a strand can be, 0 makes all strands the same, 1 lets some get very thin

spread.description: 0 packs the strands along the axis of the guide, 1 fills the whole tube

twist.description: Turns the bundle makes around the guide from base to tip

wobble.description: How far strands meander across the tube, as a share of its radius. Neighbouring strands meander together and stay inside the tube.

length_variation.description: Lets strands start above the base and end below the tip, 0 makes all of them run the whole length
